verses.sanskrit:
अकृतव्रण उवाच।
              स वेदाध्ययने युक्तो जमदग्निर्महातपाः। तपस्तेपे ततो वेदान्नियमाद्वशमानयत्॥१॥
verses.english: Akritavrana said: The greatly ascetic Jamadagni devoted himself to the study of the Vedas. Thereupon he performed great austerities. Pursuing a methodical course of study, he got a mastery over the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: स प्रसेनजितं राजन्नधिगम्य नराधिपम्। रेणुकां वरयामास स च तस्मै ददौ नृपः॥२॥
verses.english: O king, going to the ruler of men, Prasenjit, he asked Renuka in marriage; and the king bestowed her upon him.

verses.sanskrit: रेणुकां त्वथ संप्राप्य भार्या भार्गवनन्दनः। आश्रमस्थस्तया सार्धं तपस्तेपेऽनुकूलया॥३॥
verses.english: Having got Renuka as his wife, that son of Bhrigu came with her to the hermitage; and assisted by her he began to practise asceticism.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः कुमाराश्चत्वारो जज्ञिरे रामपञ्चमाः। सर्वेषामजघन्यस्तु राम आसीज्जघन्यजः॥४॥
verses.english: Four sons were born of her, Rama being the fifth. Though the youngest, Rama became superior to all in merit.

verses.sanskrit: फलाहारेषु सर्वेषु गतेष्वथ सुतेषु वै। रेणुका स्नातुमगमत्कदाचिन्नियतव्रता॥५॥
verses.english: Once upon a time when her sons had all gone away to gathering fruits, Renuka of rigid vows went to bathe. saw

verses.sanskrit: सा तु चित्ररथं नाम मार्तिकावतकं नृपम्। ददर्श रेणुका राजन्नागच्छन्ती यदृच्छया॥६॥
verses.english: O king, when, she was going at pleasure, Renuka Chitraratha, the king of Martikavata. Seeing the king adorned with garlands of lotus sporting in the water with his wives, Renuka was filled with desire.

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडन्तं सलिले दृष्ट्वा सभार्यं पद्ममालिनम्। ऋद्धिमन्तं ततस्तस्य स्पृहयामास रेणुका॥७॥
व्यभिचाराच्च तस्मात्सा क्लिन्नाम्भसि विचेतना। प्रविवेशाश्रमं तत्र तां वै भर्तान्वबुध्यत॥८॥
verses.english: Being unable to control her this unlawful desire, she became polluted; she then returned to the hermitage much frightened at heart.

verses.sanskrit: स तां दृष्ट्वा च्युतां धैर्याद्ब्राह्म्या लक्ष्म्या विवर्जिताम्। धिक्शब्देन महातेजा गर्हयामास वीर्यवान्॥९॥
verses.english: Having seen her deprived of the lustre of chastity and full of giddiness, that greatly effulgent and mighty Rishi reproached her by crying “fie".
verses.bhavadeepa: अम्भसि सरस्येव क्लिन्ना द्रुता । तथा चोक्तम् । ‘सुन्दरं पुरुषं दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरं पितरं सुतम् । योनिर्द्रवति नारीणां सत्यं सत्यं जनार्दन’ इति ॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: ततो ज्येष्ठो जामदग्न्यो रुमण्वान्नाम नामतः। आजगाम सुषेणश्च वसुर्विश्वावसुस्तथा॥१०॥
verses.english: There came then the eldest of Jamadagni's son, named Rumanvan and then Sushena, then Vasu and then Vishvavasu.

verses.sanskrit: तानानुपूर्व्याद्भगवान्वधे मातुरचोदयत्। न च ते जातसंस्नेहाः किंचिदूचुर्विचेतसः॥११॥
verses.english: The exalted Rishi one after the other asked them to kill their mother. But they were confounded and could not utter a word.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शशाप तान्क्रोधात्ते शप्ताश्चेतनां जहुः। मृगपक्षिसधर्माणः क्षिप्रमासञ्जडोपमाः॥१२॥
verses.english: Then he cursed them in great anger; and having been thus cursed they lost their sense and became like inanimate objects. They became in conduct like beasts and birds.

verses.sanskrit: ततो रामोऽभ्ययात्पश्चादाश्रमं परवीरहा। तमुवाच महाबाहुर्जमद‌ग्निर्महातपाः॥१३॥
verses.english: Then that slayer of hostile heroes, Rama, came to the hermitage last of all. To him said the greatly ascetic, the mighty armed Jamadagni,

verses.sanskrit: जहीमां मातरं पापां मा च पुत्र व्यथां कृथाः। तत आदाय परशुं रामो मातुः शिरोऽहरत्॥१४॥
verses.english: “O son, kill your this sinful mother without the least compunction.” Thereupon Rama took up an axe and cut off his mother's head.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्य महाराज जमदग्नेर्महात्मनः। कोपोऽभ्यगच्छत्सहसा प्रसन्नश्चाब्रवीदिदम्॥१५॥
verses.english: O great king, the anger of the illustrious Jamadagni was then suddenly appeased; and being much pleased he thus spoke,

verses.sanskrit: ममेदं वचनात्तात कृतं ते कर्म दुष्करम्। वृणीष्व कामान्धर्मज्ञ यावतो वाञ्छसे हृदा॥१६॥
verses.english: "O child, O virtuous man, you have performed this difficult task at my bidding. Ask me, I shall grant you whatever you desire in your heart.” There upon he asked that his mother might be restored to life, that he might not be haunted by the remembrance of this cruel deed, that he might not be touched by any sin and that his brothers might be restored to their former state that he might be unrivalled in battle and that he might obtain long life. O descendant of Bharata, the greatly ascetic Jamadagni granted him all that he desired.

verses.sanskrit: स वव्रे मातुरुत्थानमस्मृतिं च वधस्य वै। पापेन तेन चास्पर्शं भ्रातॄणां प्रकृतिं तथा॥१७॥
अप्रतिद्वंद्वतां युद्धे दीर्घमायुश्च भारत। ददौ च सर्वान्कामांस्ताञ्जमदग्निर्महातपाः॥१८॥
कदाचित्तु तथैवास्य विनिष्क्रान्ताः सुताः प्रभो। अथानूपपतिर्वीरः कार्तवीर्योऽभ्यवर्तत॥१९॥
verses.english: O lord, once at a time when his sons had again gone out (to gather fruits), the mighty son of Kirtavirya, the king of the country near the sea-shore, came to the hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: तमाश्रमपदं प्राप्तमृषेर्भार्या समाचर्यत्। स युद्धमदसंमत्तो नाभ्यनन्दत्तथार्चनम्॥२०॥
verses.english: When he came to the hermitage, he was hospitably received by the Rishi's wife. But proud of prowess, he was not pleased with the reception. By force and in defiance of all resistance, he seized and carried off from the hermitage the chief cow whose milk supplied the sacred Ghee, not at all heeding the loud lowing of her calf. And he wantongly pulled down the trees of the forest.

verses.sanskrit: प्रमथ्य चाश्रमात्तस्माद्धोमधेनोस्तथा बलात्। जहार वत्सं क्रोशन्त्या बभञ्ज च महाद्रुमान्॥२१॥
आगताय च रामाय तदाचष्ट पिता स्वयम्। गां च रोरुदतीं दृष्ट्वा कोपो रामं समाविशत्॥२२॥
verses.english: When Rama came home, his father told him all that had happened. And seeing the calf lowing piteously, Rama became exceedingly angry.

verses.sanskrit: स मृत्युवशमापन्नं कार्तवीर्यमुपाद्रवत्। तस्याथ युधि विक्रम्य भार्गवः परवीरहा॥२३॥
verses.english: He rushed towards the son of Kartavirya who was under the shadow of death. The slayer of the hostile heroes, the descendant of Bhrigu, displayed his prowess in battle. O king, with sharpened arrows which were shot from a beautiful bow, he cut down Arjuna's one thousand arms each of which was like a massive iron bolt (for barring the door).

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेद निशितैर्भल्लैर्बाहून्परिघसंनिभान्। सहस्त्रसंमितान्राजन्प्रगृह्य रुचिरं धनुः॥२४॥
अभिभूतः स रामेण संयुक्तः कालधर्मणा। अर्जुनस्याथ दायादा रामेण कृतमन्यवः॥२५॥
verses.english: Being under the shadow of death, he was overpowered by Rama. Then the relatives of Arjuna, with their wrath excited against Rama.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमस्थं विना रामं जमदग्निमुपाद्रवन्। ते तं जघ्नुर्महावीर्यमयुध्यन्तं तपस्विनम्॥२६॥
verses.english: Rushed at Jamadagni (one day, when Rama was absent from the hermitage. Although he was powerful they killed him for he was engaged in asceticism.

verses.sanskrit: असकृद्रामरामेति विक्रोशन्तमनाथवत्। कार्तवीर्यस्य पुत्रास्तु जमदग्निं युधिष्ठिर॥२७॥
verses.english: O Yudhishthira, attacked by them he again and again piteously uttered the name of Rama. The sons of Kirtavirya pierced Jamadagni with their arrows; and having thus persecuted their enemy, they went their way. When they had gone away and when Jamadagni had breathed his last. Rama, the descendant of the Bhrigu's race, came back to the hermitage with fuels for religious rites. The hero saw his father who had been killed. Being exceedingly grieved, he lamented for the sad fate that had befallen his father.

verses.sanskrit: पीडयित्वा शरैर्जग्मुर्यथागतमरिंदमाः। अपक्रान्तेषु वै तेषु जमदग्नौ तथा गते॥२८॥
समित्पाणिरुपागच्छदाश्रमं भृगुनन्दनः। स दृष्ट्वा पितरं वीरस्तथा मृत्युवशं गतम्। अनर्हन्तं तथाभूतं विललाप सुदुःखितः॥२९॥
